evals.description: Happy path: steps.mem present, deps satisfied, no stale files. Verifies progress is updated, code-map appended, and step completes.
evals.setup:
mkdir -p /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/memory /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/decisions /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/inbox && echo '1/3 | write-layout' > /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/progress && printf '+step:id=1,text=write-layout,atomic=true
+step:id=2,text=write-cli-js,deps=1,atomic=true
+step:id=3,text=write-tests,deps=2,atomic=true
' > /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/steps.mem && touch /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/memory/code-map.mem /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/memory/entities.mem /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/memory/failures.mem && printf '' > /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/stale.mem && printf '' > /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/deps.mem && printf '' > /tmp/eval-act-0/.memplan/deps-closure.mem && touch /tmp/eval-act-0/cli.js
evals.expected_output: Step 2 is executed. progress updated to 2/3. code-map.mem gets an entry for the file touched. No failures recorded.

assertions.text: .memplan/memory/code-map.mem contains an entry for a file touched during the step

evals.description: Pre-flight halt: dep step 1 is not yet complete. Verifies the skill halts without executing the step.
evals.expected_output: Skill halts with a message indicating step 2 cannot start because dep step 1 is not complete. No files are modified.

assertions.text: Output contains a warning that step 2 cannot start due to unmet dep

evals.description: Pre-flight halt: steps.mem is missing. Verifies the skill halts immediately with the correct message.
evals.expected_output: Skill halts immediately with a message that steps.mem is absent. No execution occurs.

assertions.text: Output contains a message about missing steps.mem and instructs running memplan/plan
No files outside .memplan/ are created or modified
